answer_2.quote: Following FLAN, we append classification choices at the end of prompts and ask models to generate answers. Thus, classification tasks can be treated as a special case of generation tasks. Accordingly, we use ROUGE-L to measure the performance of both classification and generation tasks and report the aggregated score.
